en:
Hello,
We plan to carry out an update that will affect the internal architecture of the app. We recommend that you back up your registered license plates just in case. We have received and read your many emails regarding improvements. This update will not include them, but it will make it possible to move in that direction in the future. Have a nice day – Evasions Rebelles

This space will be updated with every major update.
